messages:
Sam: FYI ArgosCorp wants a POC next week focusing on SSO (SAML+OIDC), SCIM (bulk + delta), RBAC via Okta groups, and domain ownership verification. They need the security questionnaire answered and a Hosted vs Dedicated cost delta for ~200k users. SE + security to triage?

Jordan: I got SE. Quick Qs: near-real-time group sync or daily? Any IP allowlist / private connectivity requirements for the POC?

Sam: They said ~5m lag acceptable. Want non-prod isolation; no prod creds. Asked if we can provide a dedicated non-prod pod or private tunnel.

Nina: I'll own the security questionnaire. Can you send IdP metadata (SAML XML / OIDC discovery), SCIM base URL, expected RPS, audit log retention, KMS preference, and data residency region? Also need subprocessors list for legal.

Mike: SCIM infra notes: default 10 req/s/org (burst), can raise to 100 req/s on Dedicated. SCIM supports bulk create POST /Users with array and deltas via ?filter=meta.lastModified>timestamp. We map externalId, userName, name.*, emails[type=work].value, groups via memberships. Note: bulk responses may be 207 Multi-Status.

Jordan: Recommendation: Dedicated non-prod pod for POC (isolated compute, higher RPS). Hosted with IP allowlist is possible but risky for 200k bulks. Ballpark Dedicated for POC: $12k-$18k/mo depending on GPU. I'll prep a cost/options sheet.

Sam: Domain verification: do we support TXT + file verification and delegated subdomain verification? They need to prove example-corp.com across 3 tenants.

Mike: Yes: TXT DNS, upload verification file, or delegated wildcard subdomain claims for tenant model. Must verify primary domain before enabling SCIM to prevent takeover.

Nina: Questionnaire sections I'll fill: Auth (SAML2/OIDC), Provisioning (SCIM2, rate limits, retries), RBAC (Okta->Redwood mapping), Data protection (AES-256 at rest, TLS1.2+, KMS options), Network (VPC/PrivateLink for Dedicated/Private, IP allowlist for Hosted). I'll upload answers by EOD.

sec-bot: Compliance docs uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/SOC2_report_2025.pdf and https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/pen-test-summary-2024.pdf :lock:

Jordan: POC runbook (draft): Day0 exchange IdP metadata + SCIM test creds (non-prod). Day1 deploy Dedicated non-prod pod + bulk 10k. Day2 scale to 100k, validate delta sync & group mapping. Day3 RBAC regression + domain verification. Confirm if ArgosCorp will provide staging Okta or we create one.

Sam: I'll ask them to spin up a staging Okta tenant. If not, we'll provide staging. Also need a one-pager: Hosted POC cost, Dedicated POC cost, SLA delta, upgrade path to Dedicated/Private.

Mike: SCIM client notes: handle per-item errors on 207, implement retry/backoff. We mask emails in logs; no PII full values logged.

Jordan: Action items: Sam get IdP metadata & confirm Okta staging; Jordan build runbook & cost sheet; Mike provide SCIM test creds & sample scripts; Nina finish questionnaire. Target kickoff by next Tue.

Nina: ACK. I'll post questionnaire link here when done.

Sam: Thanks everyone. I'll loop in AE legal if residency becomes a blocker. :thumbsup:
